constraints.living_definition: On-demand append and recovery from verified Δ events; 'alive' expresses maintained design intent, not sentience, autonomous execution, or continuous observation

intended_operating_design.mode: Astra / Golden Chain metric rail (spec only)

ACTIVE.1.purpose: Requested ingestion, inventory, exact duplicate proof, and owner-authorized cleanup only

PASSIVE.2.purpose: Hypothesis-only near-duplicate discovery, alternative quality ranking, and missing-evidence tracking

canonical_copy_priority: preserve owner-identified original or reference image
preserve highest-fidelity unique master and editable source
preserve provenance, captions, metadata and dates where needed
preserve variants with meaningful visual differences
when truly identical and same retention class, retain earliest owner-stated or oldest verified Library copy

anti_loop.duplicate_key: sha256(source_bytes) OR sha256(normalized_pixel_bytes|width|height|mode), scoped to documented equivalence

design_for_quality.promotion_gate: SOURCE_IMAGE → SPEC_CONSTRAINTS → PER_FILE_BYTES → VALIDATED_RATIO → VISUAL_QC → USER_ACCEPTANCE_RECEIPT
design_for_quality.failed_output: retain failure receipt, no fabricated image success or invisible queue

probability_machine.role: Calibrated decision support; never independent evidence of image delivery, authorship, ownership, or safe deletion
probability_machine.measured_event: P(two files represent one materially identical image | audited pairwise features)
probability_machine.promotion_thresholds: NOT_CALIBRATED; no numeric decision thresholds until signed dataset and holdout evaluation

metric_register.unit: verified matches / all proposed duplicate matches

comparative_target.required_method: pre-register same dataset, hardware/provider constraints, quality rubric, costs, latency, reliability and statistical uncertainty; compare against measured baseline; never report 10x without results

provenance_and_rights.confidential_information_note: GitHub repository is public; no secrets, proprietary external source code, or personal photographs embedded in this spec.
